listings.title: my shirt — Coast Range
listings.description: The original "my shirt" art: clean lowercase wordmark over misty Coast Range peaks and a calm inlet.

ingest.note: Original art file never existed (it was generated as a mockup).

listings.printNote: Production print files regenerated as clean flat artwork (AI-generated recreation of the original mockup print at 1024 px, keyed to transparent and upscaled 3x to 2836 x 2257 px ≈ 284 dpi at 10 in). The upscale is interpolated, so fine detail is soft; fine for DTG at ~10 in, but a vector/hand-cleaned redraw would be sharper. Light shirts use the dark-teal ink version. Turquoise tee photo is the owner's original mockup.

tee.name: Turquoise
tee.why: The owner's own mockup colour — real product photo; white-ink print as designed.

tee.name: White
tee.why: Always offered; uses the dark-teal ink version so the wordmark stays readable.

tee.name: Heather Mint
tee.why: Pastel sea-glass green that echoes the misty water; dark-teal ink.

tee.name: Baby Blue
tee.why: Soft sky pastel that matches the coastal scene; dark-teal ink.

tee.name: Heather Prism Lilac
tee.why: Pastel dusk tone for variety beyond blues/greens; dark-teal ink.

tee.name: True Royal
tee.why: One bold colourful option where the original white-ink print pops.

longsleeve.name: Light Blue
longsleeve.why: Closest pastel to the coast palette; dark-teal ink.

longsleeve.name: Carolina Blue
longsleeve.why: Brighter mid-blue, still light enough for dark ink.

longsleeve.name: Royal
longsleeve.why: Colourful option carrying the original white-ink print.

hoodie.name: Sapphire
hoodie.why: Gildan 18500's closest match to the turquoise original; white-ink print.

hoodie.name: Orchid
hoodie.why: Pastel lilac for variety; dark-teal ink.

listings.title: (HA)ₙ Celtic Knot
listings.description: The owner's hyaluronic-acid Celtic-knot mark: teal and silver triquetra in parentheses with subscript n, the formula (C14H21NO11)n and the caption "D-glucuronic acid · N-acetyl-D-glucosamine".

ingest.note: Off-white background removed to transparent; check the small caption line is legible at ~10 in print width (needs ≥ ~150 dpi).

tee.name: White
tee.why: Always offered; the teal/silver ink reads cleanly.

tee.name: Heather Mint
tee.why: Pastel that harmonises with the teal knot.

tee.name: Baby Blue
tee.why: Pastel cool tone; teal stays visible.

tee.name: Heather Prism Lilac
tee.why: Pastel contrast to teal.

tee.name: Soft Pink
tee.why: Warm pastel contrast; no dark colours because the dark-teal ink would disappear.

longsleeve.name: Daisy
longsleeve.why: Light, cheerful pastel yellow; teal still reads.

listings.printNote: Print file 1389px wide ≈ 139 dpi at 10 in (low — ask for a larger original before production). Mode: remove-bg. Caption line is ~0.17 in tall at 10 in width (≈12 pt caps) in thin light grey-teal: legible but faint, especially on Heather Mint/Lilac.

listings.title: Search Me — cologne for two
listings.description: "Search Me" — two scents, one connection: two navy bottles with gold caps nested along a curve, on a soft blue backdrop.

ingest.note: Photographic print with its soft-blue backdrop kept as a rounded panel.

tee.name: Heather Prism Lilac
tee.why: Soft pastel that flatters the cool blue palette.

tee.name: Heather Navy
tee.why: Echoes the navy bottles; makes the light panel pop.

tee.name: Soft Pink
tee.why: Warm pastel contrast for a gift/couples look.

listings.printNote: Print file 1024px wide ≈ 102 dpi at 10 in (low — ask for a larger original before production). Mode: photo. Photo prints as a full rectangular panel (backdrop included).

listings.title: Search Me — silver statue
listings.description: "Search Me": a chrome sculpture in a glass case on a white marble pedestal, in a bright classical room.

ingest.note: Use remove-bg instead if the photo has a plain backdrop.
